subject: SOW threshold & temporary PO grace period proposal
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@smallcloud.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question about PO requirement for our pilot SOW

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick intro call this morning — excited to get the pilot started. I ran this past our finance team and they asked whether Redwood can accept an invoice-only path for the pilot SOW (under $10k). Our standard onboarding takes 6–8 weeks when a PO is required, and the pilot timeline is tight.

Attached: smallcloud_onboarding_form.pdf (vendor intake form)

If there's a short-term alternative (temporary invoice lane, or a one-off exception), what info would you need from us? I can provide SOC attestations and references quickly.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Revenue Operations
SmallCloud.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@smallcloud.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question about PO requirement for our pilot SOW

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the intake form. Short answer: we can consider a monitored, temporary invoice-only lane for small pilot SOWs, provided we have a minimal evidence package and a time-boxed grace period.

Requesting procurement input from Karthik (cc). Karthik, high level ask from the vendor: pilot SOW ~ $7k, start next week. Vendor can provide SOC2 summary, a redacted MSA, and two customer references. Can we do a 30-day invoice-only pilot exception with the following controls?
- Maximum cumulative spend during pilot: $10,000
- Evidence: SOC2 type II summary + signed MSA or redline summary + 2 references
- Billing cadence: net 30 invoices to finance@redwood.com with "Pilot Exception: SmallCloud.ai" on the subject
- Procurement hold: Finance to confirm completion of evidence within 7 days of signing; exception auto-reverts to PO-required after 30 days

I've attached a quick matrix with proposed thresholds — happy to iterate.

Attachments: proposed-grace-period-matrix.xlsx

Elena — if that's acceptable I can coordinate approvals and loop Marissa on contract/admin steps.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick question about PO requirement for our pilot SOW

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear proposal. Procurement is willing to pilot a tightly-scoped invoice-only lane with those controls, subject to two additions:
1) Vendor must accept an audit clause limited to pilot scope (we won't require a full procurement attestation, but need the right to audit invoiced pilot activity).
2) Accounting wants a single-point contact and an invoice template to ensure automated ingest into our AP system.

If SmallCloud agrees to the audit clause and provides the invoice template, procurement can approve a 30-day exception capped at $10k. We will require a signed internal approval (Head of Sales + Head of Finance) before first invoice is paid.

Hannah — can you own the finance contact confirmation? Marissa — can you prep the contract addendum language (short rider) for sign-off?

Karthik
Director, Procurement

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@smallcloud.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick question about PO requirement for our pilot SOW

Elena —

Good news: procurement sign-off pending acceptance of two quick items Karthik called out (audit clause limited to pilot; invoice template). Finance confirmed they will route first invoice for expedited approval if we include "Pilot Exception: SmallCloud.ai" on the subject line and the invoice matches the template.

Next steps for SmallCloud to get going (can you confirm by EOD Tuesday):
- Send back the completed onboarding form (we have your draft) + SOC2 summary and redacted MSA
- Attach an invoice sample template (pdf/word) matching your billing system
- Confirm acceptance of short audit clause (I pasted proposed 1-paragraph rider below)

If we get those, Marissa will build a 1-page rider and I will route for signatures (Head of Sales + Head of Finance). Once signed, procurement will allow the 30-day, $10k capped invoice lane.

Proposed audit rider (summary): "For the limited duration of the Pilot Exception, Redwood Inference may request records related to billed pilot activity to verify invoiced amounts; such requests will be scoped to pilot invoices and performed no more than once per pilot term."

Elena — happy to hop on a 15-min call if you want to walk through the checklist.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
